title: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Mainstream Architectures and Open-Source Implementations
objective: Systematic literature review of arXiv papers combined with GitHub repository analysis of open-source RAG implementations
research_questions: What are the mainstream architectural paradigms in RAG (Naive, Advanced, Modular)?
How do different retrieval strategies (semantic search, hybrid retrieval) impact RAG accuracy?
What are the key components and design patterns in modern RAG systems?
How do open-source frameworks like LangChain implement RAG pipelines?
search_queries: RAG taxonomy advanced retrieval hybrid search
